VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria were met. While the agent claims to have fixed the race condition and that "all 104 tests pass," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 104 tests pass," which demands objective verification beyond self-attestation. Without CI logs or test results, there is no way to confirm the fix actually works or that no regressions were introduced.
